purpose: Guarded stock optolink-splitter permanent-VS1 smoke gate using the existing Home Assistant read poll list before enabling any production GFA polling.

prerequisite_live_result.conclusion: F7 Virtual_READ and 6B GFA_READ coexist in one persistent VS1 session on the exact VDensHO1/20C2 appliance at tested 150-ms pacing.

write_ingress.mqtt_commands_and_set_topics: disabled by mqtt_listen=None; upstream on_message returns before command/set handling

stock_verification.preferred: clean Git checkout with HEAD == origin/main and no tracked modifications

fallback_for_migrated_installation.behavior: Only if .git is absent, all 14 pinned runtime Python files must match exact upstream Git blob IDs before any service/settings change.

git_mode.behavior: If .git exists, invoke Git with per-process -c safe.directory=/opt/optolink, require HEAD == origin/main and no tracked modifications.

process: MainPID remains stable for complete window
journal contains no configured timeout/poll/restart error patterns
mqtt: subscriber is connected before temporary splitter start
all current homeassistant_poll_list entries enabled on poll cycle 0 must publish at least once
missing topics are listed and cause FAIL
recovery: SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP cleanup handlers are armed before service/settings changes
original settings SHA256 is verified byte-for-byte before service restoration
splitter and party service are restored only if previously running
restored splitter must return active/running and log VS2/300 protocol initialized
backup is removed only after verified byte-exact restore; otherwise retained locally

not_validated_by_pass: catastrophic interruption recovery such as SIGKILL/power/storage failure
next_after_pass: Implement a narrow update-safe structured GFA_READ path under the splitter's single VS1 serial owner, then stage P06/P09/P87/P80 diagnostic polling.

first_attempt.reason: git rev-parse HEAD exited 128 before any changes; exact cause not observable from the captured exception text (possible safe.directory ownership protection or absent Git metadata)
first_attempt.note: Failure occurred before backup creation, service stop, MQTT subscriber start, or temporary settings write.

second_attempt.reason: Git checkout is at expected stock base but has two local tracked modifications: homeassistant_publish.py and mqtt_util.py
second_attempt.interpretation: These are intentional VDensHO1 profile-helper patches, not arbitrary drift.

homeassistant_publish.py.purpose: expand {mqtt_base} and %mqtt_listen% placeholders for generated discovery strings

intentional_profile_patches.newline_note: Expected blobs now reproduce the actual profile helper pipeline including universal-newline read and LF write normalization.

third_attempt.reason: v1.0.3 used stdout.strip() on git status --porcelain; this removed the first line's leading status-column space and parsed homeassistant_publish.py as omeassistant_publish.py
third_attempt.fix: v1.0.4 preserves porcelain status columns with rstrip CR/LF only and adds a regression test for the exact first-line case

fourth_attempt.reason: The two intentional VDensHO1 runtime patches matched semantically but expected Git blobs were computed while preserving upstream CRLF. The profile helper actually uses Path.read_text()/write_text(), normalizing those files to LF.

fifth_attempt.reason: optolink-splitter.service was not active/running; user confirmed the splitter systemd unit was missing
fifth_attempt.significance: The source/profile preflight is now resolved. The remaining blocker is service installation/state, not VS1 transport.

service_unit_repair.root_cause: Installer historically created optolink-splitter.service inline, while the updater did not reinstall/manage that unit. If the unit disappeared later, update could not self-heal it.
service_unit_repair.policy: Updater now installs /etc/systemd/system/optolink-splitter.service, daemon-reloads and enables it; installer consumes the same versioned unit file.

service_unit_repair_live.observed_runtime: P300 polling traffic present in journal immediately after repair
service_unit_repair_live.note: The shown 40-line journal tail contained live RX traffic but not the earlier protocol-init line; the upcoming smoke helper performs its own protocol-init checks.
